recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It preserves FHIR-32865's MAR guidance while aligning element-path examples with the current source model; no work-group decision is needed unless Pharmacy wants a broader editorial rewrite of the MAR page.
issue_request: FHIR-32865 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for R5 asking to add Medication Administration Record guidance to MedicationAdministration section 11.2.5, based on the Confluence Medication Administration Lists page.
initial_application: Commit 26e2a822594c064e06e61e26e5d1d2560c2c9fda, merged by 874c259a45661a3731b8b8915de80b730a173481, copied the Confluence MAR guidance into source/medicationadministration/medicationadministration-notes.xml. Later cleanups adjusted some copied path text, including a68b6567bf3bf79008f25d7974edc76b9b91c75a and FHIR-41380, but the scheduled-MedicationRequest rows still used obsolete dosage/dosageInstructions paths after the current dosage model changed.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration is active and approved in source/fhir.ini. The current MedicationRequest source defines dosageInstruction as DosageDetails; DosageDetails uses step.component to hold Dosage entries; Dosage defines timing, route, site, and doseAndRate.dose/rate. The existing MAR guidance still pointed readers to MedicationRequest.dosage.dose[x] and MedicationRequest.dosageInstructions.dosage.* paths, which no longer correspond to the current source model. Community searches found the originating Confluence guidance and Pharmacy minutes, with no directly relevant Zulip conflict.
reconciliation: Updated only the MAR table element labels in active MedicationAdministration notes: MedicationRequest dose/rate/timing/route/site now reference dosageInstruction.step.component and doseAndRate/timing/route/site, and the MedicationAdministration dose/rate row now names the full rate path. No clinical guidance text or resource semantics changed.
source_changes: source/medicationadministration/medicationadministration-notes.xml: updated the MAR guidance table to use current MedicationRequest.dosageInstruction.step.component paths for dose/rate/timing/route/site and the full MedicationAdministration.dosage.rate[x] path.

related_jiras.note: Corrected the MedicationAdministration occurrence choice wording in the same MAR table, showing this section already had path-maintenance updates after the initial FHIR-32865 copy.
